findings.title: Name the projective pairs as the dihedral generators
findings.reasoning: The pronoun 'their' grammatically refers to the products. The individual projective products have orders 2, 3, 5 and generate cyclic groups of those orders. The corresponding pairs of projective involutions generate the claimed dihedral groups of orders 4, 6, 10.
findings.proposed_repair: State the product orders separately, then say that the corresponding pairs of involutions in H/Z generate dihedral groups of orders 4, 6, 10.
findings.evidence: Fresh exact check confirms product orders 4, 3, 10, pair-subgroup orders 8, 12, 20, and total generated group order 120.
